title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Late-Charge Base Drawn from Rental Invoice Components
content:
# Billing Operations Clause — Late-Charge Base from the Parts of the Rental Invoice, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Clause.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the late-charge base is figured from the parts of the invoice: for an invoice dated on or before the turn-in date and no more than 30 days before it, it is that invoice's depreciation and lease charge less the business payments applied to that month; for any other invoice that carries sales tax, it is the invoice amount less its sales tax and less the business payments applied to that month; for any other invoice that carries no sales tax, it is the invoice amount less the business payments applied to that month; in every case never below zero.

**Records read.** The most recent rental invoice's date, amount and its component lines — depreciation, lease charge and sales tax; the turn-in date the unit records; the payments recorded against that invoice month. Days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one.

## Branch table

| The invoice | Late-charge base |
|---|---|
| dated on the turn-in date, or 1 to 30 days before it | depreciation plus lease charge, less payments applied to that month, never below zero |
| any other invoice carrying sales tax (including every invoice of a unit with no turn-in date, and an invoice dated after the turn-in date or more than 30 days before it) | invoice amount less sales tax, less payments applied to that month, never below zero |
| any other invoice carrying no sales tax | invoice amount less payments applied to that month, never below zero |

## Cases (hypothetical invoice: depreciation 600.00, lease charge 150.00, management fee 30.00, sales tax 46.80, amount 826.80; no payments)

1. Dated 30 days before the turn-in date: base 750.00 (depreciation and lease charge).
2. Dated 31 days before the turn-in date: base 780.00 (amount less sales tax).
3. Dated on the turn-in date itself: base 750.00.
4. The unit has not been turned in: base 780.00.
5. The same invoice without sales tax (amount 780.00), dated 45 days before turn-in: base 780.00.
6. Dated 20 days before turn-in, with 800.00 recorded against the month: 750.00 less 800.00 is below zero, so the base is 0.00.
